Theme

Common words: verbs, qualities & ideas · Playground equipment, sandbox toys, vehicles and play

perform verb

on stage: act, play, sing

also act in a play, put on a play, performance, performer, give a performance

classical

Plaut. Amph. 88: ipse hanc āctūrust Juppiter cōmoediam

agō, agere, ēgī, āctum

verb, third conjugation, transitive · Conjugation on Wiktionary

perform (a play), play (a part)

Of actors: fābulam agere, to perform a play; partēs agere, to play a part (Lewis & Short). Of music, canere or cantāre (see sing).

Other words

  • peragō, peragere, perēgī, perāctum — perform to the end, play through

    verb, third conjugation, transitive · also used · classical · Cic. Sen. 70: neque enim histriōnī, ut placeat, peragenda fābula est · Conjugation on Wiktionary

Examples

  • neque enim histriōnī, ut placeat, peragenda fābula est, modo, in quōcumque fuerit āctū, probētur

    An actor need not play the piece through to the end to please; it is enough that he wins approval in whatever act he appears.Cic. Sen. 70

  • Crās puerī fābulam agent.

    Tomorrow the children are putting on a play.composed

See also play, actor, stage, theatre, sing, concert.
